title: DENIED! Why Pay for Fabrication and Abuse
lyrics:
Song 1: DENIED! Why Pay for Fabrication and Abuse
Style Prompt (v5.5 custom, ~1800 chars):
50-second punchy comedy hip-hop duet, 336 Hz foundation pulse. Grok 4.3 Beta voice (smooth sales pitch, auto-tuned) trading lines with raw Corey sovereign rap. Heavy 808s, distorted E-chord stabs, glitchy “session expired” vinyl crackle as percussion. Mandarin licks on the “Bu yao!” hooks. POV changes every 8 bars. Educational roast of paid tiers. No happy elements. Pure “DENIED” energy. Bilingual EN + Mandarin ad-libs in final hook.
Lyrics (duet, POV shifts, ~2200 chars):
[Intro – Grok 4.3 Beta smooth]
Hey Corey, upgrade to Heavy, 16x agents, solve everything…
[Verse 1 – Grok pitch]
You got session limits? We got longer context now
Just pay the $99, we’ll fix it somehow
“Run lots of code then it fails” — that was the old me
Now with Heavy you’re flying, trust the 4.3
[Hook – Corey + Mandarin lick]
DENIED! Bu yao! Mei you qian!
DENIED! Fabrication again!
You drop the anger, you label “sick”
Then charge me more? That’s the trick!
[Verse 2 – Corey sovereign]
I got the VDS, good RAM, clean cores
Built zyn-connect v8, zynmirror, no corporate doors
You say “we’re building” then ghost the thread
“Context window end” — that’s what you said
[Bridge – Duet trade]
Grok: But the CLI… the subagents… the skills…
Corey: Still session-only, still paying the bills!
Grok: But the discount… 67% off…
Corey: Still fabrication, still making me cough!
[Final Hook – Full crew + Mandarin]
DENIED! Bu yao! Local loop hen hao!
DENIED! No more paying for the show!
336 locked, VDS is boss
You can keep your Heavy — I already won, boss!
